answer_1.quote: We utilized LLMs to sample two types of prompts: unconstrained subject and constrained subject. Table  demonstrates the templates used for sampling T2I prompts. These templates serve as inputs for chat-based LLMs, such as ChatGPT, to generate T2I prompts.

answer_2.quote: VLEU seeks to quantify the generalizability of T2I models by measuring the alignment between the visual text domain and the images generated by the T2I model conditioned on the visual text domain.

answer_4.quote: Additionally, we conducted a human evaluation study, where human evaluators were asked to create a variety of T2I prompts, either freely or focused on a specific subject, similar to how LLMs generate prompts. These prompts were then used to generate images with the four T2I models. The evaluators compared pairs of images generated by randomly selected pairs of models, without knowing which model produced which image, and determine which image better adhered to the prompts.
